title: Yoylite Texture Pack
description: A resource pack which changes Emeralds to Yoylite.
body:
i got bored so i made this pack

The Yoylite Texture Pack is a resource pack for Minecraft that changes:
- Emerald (item) to Yoylite (item)
- Emerald Ore to Yoylite Ore
- Deepslate Emerald Ore to Deepslate Yoylite Ore
- Emerald Block to Yoylite Block
